operation.normalized_request: Closed Request: project from URL; absent limit resolves20, absent cursor resolvesnull; not a POST body.

query.limit: canonical decimal1..50, fixed normalized value for entire traversal
query.cursor: server-issued unpadded base64url1..4096 chars; echo unchanged

transport.authorization: one trusted-host owner Bearer header; cursor is never a credential

authority.current_checks: Current registry owner, unrevoked Store coordinator, exact company/project and durable sole-owner room before protected reads/cursor interpretation and final return.
authority.access_digest: SHA256 C01canonical current kind/principal_id/sortedpermissions/sortedproject_ids/Storeprincipal/audience/visibilitypolicy. Excludes rotating credential ID, token fingerprint and expiry.
authority.access_change: Current denial401/403 first; still-authorized changed effective access409 RESYNC_REQUIRED.
authority.unsupported_ABA: No access epoch. Arbitrary remove-and-regrant under an alive issuer unsupported; registry replacement/restore requires listener recreation.

anchors: exact watermark Message reference including digest
snapshot.later_appends: Excluded above committed watermark; cannot shift traversed ranges.
snapshot.repeat_cursor: Stateless current-authorized same request returns identical successful bytes/range/items/next token until expiry, with no hidden advancement.
snapshot.initial_request: Always a new cut; never silently restart a continuation. After a lost initial reply, caller explicitly starts a new traversal.
snapshot.completion: Only for the issued owner-room cut; no full C07 manifest/event replay/SSE.

lifetime.expiry: initialmin(issue+TTL, initialcredentialexpiry); never extended by pages or rotation
lifetime.units: integer UTC epoch milliseconds; observed_at is cut issue observation, not read freshness; internal monotonic deadline also enforced
lifetime.checks: Before reads and immediately before return; backward beforeissue409, wall or monotonicexpiry410.

paging.select: Indexed owner/room/scope sequences<=start<=watermark; limit+1 lookahead, noCOUNT.
paging.validate: Both cut anchors and every bounded selected wrapper/receipt/claim/journal before bytefit; no skip or corruption hidden by omission.
paging.bytes: Longest whole prefix includes cursor/envelope/escaping/references/digests; next=last ACTUALLY returned sequence-1.
paging.range: Initialstart=watermarkrevision; continuationstart=priornext; items contiguous descending; end=lastreturned.
paging.terminal: has_morefalse/cursornull/nextnull/end1; emptyinitial has null head/anchor/range and items[].
paging.coverage: partial/item_limit orbyte_limit whilemore; complete_for_cut/none onlyterminal; total_countnull

receiver_checks: Retain permitted company/project, normalized fixedlimit, issued snapshot/cursor/range expectations before credential await. Cursor/principal prose/echo never grants access.
Strict rawoutput262144 beforeparse, command32768 unchanged. Validate closed schema and all frozen canonical records/fullrefs/digests. Reconstructed appendcommand is INTERNAL consistency only.
Validate watermark_head separately; first item matches watermark_message_ref on initialcut. Retain full snapshot/head/anchors exactly acrosspages; never infer snapshot from timestamps.

Require sequences=start-index, unique IDs/sequences within/acrosspages, start=priornext, end=last and next=end-1 whilemore. Terminal end1 or allnull for emptycut. No head substitution or kind:id collapse.
Bind requested_limit exactly. No limit/order/filter change; normalized absent20 and explicit20 are equivalent. URL query order irrelevant.
Snapshot issued<expires<=issued+900000, observation=issue; same incarnation/accessdigest/anchors acrosspages. Server owns signature/authority/monotonic checks.
On409/410 RESYNC_REQUIRED discard traversal and explicitly request a fresh cut; never splice snapshots or silently skip to head. No unbounded client auto-fetch required.

digests.page: complete page excluding only own top-leveldigest

cursor_security.encoding: Canonical unpadded base64url closed canonicalpayload+32byte HMACSHA256; verify signature before JSON; protocol domain separation.
cursor_security.opacity: Client echo only, not confidentiality. No secrets, private paths, token fingerprints or global sequences. Only authorized room sequence.
cursor_security.key: Fresh per-listener host key/incarnation; key never serialized.

restart_restore.supported: Stoplistener, offline existingStore restore, freshlistener/key/incarnation; oldtokens resync. Fixture performs real SQLite task-backup restore.
restart_restore.unsupported: Live/in-place restore under aliveissuer, generalized restoreepoch/C17, fullC07 snapshot/events/SSE.

proof_scope: Local synthetic Store/verifiedsamehostTLS historypagination only; no UI/eventdelivery/employee/model/native/account/cloud/pilot/fullC03C07/company acceptance.
